title: GreenGateway Configuration Capabilities
description: What a running gateway reports at GET /v1{ADMIN_PREFIX}/config/capabilities (admin:config:read) and what ggctl reads before any configuration operation. The document is closed: a member this version does not define, a duplicate member, or a value outside its grammar makes it unreadable, and a reader that does not implement this exact apiVersion and kind treats the server as incompatible. The documents and operations lists are open sets: a reader asks only whether the one document version and operation it is about to use are listed, and refuses anything that is not. A gateway in environment mode lists no documents and no operations. This schema is necessary but not sufficient: the shared reader in the gateway-config crate is authoritative.

apiVersion.description: Exact document version. No other version, prefix, or spelling is accepted.

gatewayVersion.description: The gateway binary's release version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release or build suffix of ASCII letters, digits, dots, and hyphens.

sourceMode.description: Where the gateway's deployment configuration comes from. Only environment mode exists in this version.

documents.description: The configuration document versions the server accepts in configuration requests.

operations.description: The configuration operations the server has enabled.
